title: REFLECTIONS
author: Aarti Mittal
text:
Life,
if not easy....
it is not that difficult..
the attitude makes it a cult

some learning
some unlearning
some rejection
some acceptance
a reflection
with the flow

life,
is a brook
with debris
some in the depth
some with flow
some leaving behind
makes it flow...

a brook..
a river...
flows, never looking back
only forward
to reach its destination
the sea.
stanzas: the attitude makes it a cult
